description: IT Glue JSON:API surface for organizations, contacts, passwords, configurations, and documents, including the write endpoints needed for MSP automation

novel_features.name: Fleet-wide cross-resource search
novel_features.description: Search every synced organization, contact, password (metadata), configuration, and document at once, with the owning client shown for each hit.

novel_features.name: Per-org documentation coverage scorecard
novel_features.description: Rank organizations by documentation completeness — counts of configurations, contacts, passwords, and documents per client, thinnest first.

novel_features.name: Password rotation / staleness audit
novel_features.description: List credentials whose last update is older than a threshold, grouped by client and sorted oldest-first — metadata only, the secret value is never read.

novel_features.name: Duplicate-contact detection
novel_features.description: Find contacts that share a normalized name or email within (or across) an organization — the duplicates that overlapping PSA syncs leave behind.

novel_features.name: Org consolidated brief
novel_features.description: Assemble everything known about one client — contacts, configurations, password metadata, and documents — in a single offline read.

novel_features.name: Cross-resource change feed
novel_features.description: Show every record updated since a timestamp across all five resources, newest first, optionally narrowed to one resource type.

novel_features.name: Orphaned-record detector
novel_features.description: Find configurations, contacts, passwords, and documents whose organization-id no longer resolves to a synced organization.
